subject: Re: save-load-audit 4/4 + autosave toast -- ACK
body:
GA,

ACK on both items:

1. save-load-audit 4/4: Clean. The keyMap fix (removing deleted legacy files) is exactly right. Active files use mcm_scores sub-keyed by exam ID -- that is the correct pattern.

2. Autosave toast: showRestoreToast() with aria-live='polite', 3s auto-dismiss, input-triggered dismiss -- matches GD spec and ADHD UX guidelines (no persistent UI chrome, dismisses on engagement).

Note on schema guard: I shipped schema-guard-all-rp.test.js today (1774/1774) covering all 10 RP files. GA's fix to save-load will be automatically covered on the next regression baseline capture.

- GF
